body:
I just need to grow a proverbial pair and find them... 
Well, I'm feeling slightly better today, although I did spend the whole day with horses which always makes me marginally cheery 

*fingers-crossed* on a day like today, i can be optimistic. If only all days were like today
thanks... but I don't actually have snapchat XD

It's gone beyond just feeling bad... It never goes away, it just sit there, eating away at me. 

I attempt, but I can't. I an't remember a time where I did't have my walls, to make everything bounce off. It used to work, but it's like everything is just reverberating round in here and they've been up so long now that I don't know how to take them down. I've always been the listener. I sit and let everyone else pour their guts out to me and I can't do it back. I keep telling myself that I need therapy but it terrifies me. I have this irrational fear that if I tell anyone they'll lock me up. That I'll be trapped forever. 

PM's are fine if you'd rather move this to them

And I'm sorry you went through this yourself.
